description:
From giant rocket-powered wheels to nuclear weapons dropped on North Carolina farmland, military history contains verified facts stranger than fiction. This episode examines declassified records behind the Great Panjandrum, the Davy Crockett tactical nuke, bat bombs, D-Day deception operations, high-altitude nuclear tests, the Berlin Airlift, and the CIA's submarine recovery.
